module: Test extension for the point-of-interest (POI) system. It adds a dummy "poiTest" POI on each parking spot defined in the file gameplay/parkingSpotTests.sites.json, and a "Do the Test" button in the POI detail window that only prints "Test Successfull!" to the log. It is only for the game's developers to test gameplay_markerInteraction / rawPois; a modder can use it as a minimal example of a POI provider.
usage:
-- Minimal example of a POI provider (same structure as poiTest)
local function onGetRawPoiListForLevel(levelIdentifier, elements)
  table.insert(elements, {id='monPoi', pos=vec3(0,0,0), rot=quat(0,0,0,1), scl=vec3(1,1,1), radius=3, visibleInPlayMode=true, interactableInPlayMode=true, clusterType='parkingMarker', data={type='monPoi', id='monPoi', name='Mon POI'}})
end
notes: The sites file gameplay/parkingSpotTests.sites.json is loaded via gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites on every call of onGetRawPoiListForLevel; if it does not exist, accessing .parkingSpots.sorted may raise an error (inferred from code).
Each POI created has the id "Test-PS-<parking spot id>", a radius of 3 and clusterType "parkingMarker".
On load, onExtensionLoaded clears the gameplay_markerInteraction cache to force the POI list to be rebuilt.

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: Hook called by the POI system (gameplay_rawPois) when it rebuilds a level's POI list. Adds to `elements` one "poiTest" type POI per parking spot of the test file (fields id, pos, rot, scl, radius=3, visibleInPlayMode, interactableInPlayMode, clusterType, data).

levelIdentifier.desc: Level identifier (not used by this function).

onPoiDetailPromptOpening.desc: Hook called when a POI's detail window opens. If one of the elements is of type "poiTest", adds to `promptData` a "Do the Test" button whose action writes "Test Successfull!" to the console.

elemData.desc: List of the POI data (`data`) under the cursor / in the cluster.

promptData.desc: List of buttons to complete ({label, buttonText, buttonFun}).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads: clears the gameplay_markerInteraction cache (clearCache) so that the test POIs appear.
